name: pnp-sharepoint-skills-guided-list-form
title: Guided Form
shortDescription: A conversational, one-question-at-a-time HTML form in Copilot's interactive preview that adds one new item to a SharePoint list.
longDescription: Reads the current list's columns and opens a Guided Form in Copilot's interactive HTML preview: a welcome step, one question at a time, a review screen, and a finish screen after Submit.

The look is fixed by a mandatory skeleton in reference.html, in the Tech Ease palette. Copilot loads that file, copies it byte-for-byte, and fills in question data only. Submit sends the answers back to Copilot as a chat message. The submitted answers do not include the list address. The list item is created only after the person confirms the item card.
